svg.title: FlavorWeave shopping entities
svg.desc: Household list in the center, recipe projection on the left, provider handoff on the right. Pantry is noted as not built.
svg.text: Canonical list, with fulfillment kept beside it
S-01 sketch. Not a schema migration.
Dinner plan
Existing. Pins, guests, adaptation.
scaleForDiners stays here.
dinner_shop_line is the projection
cache, not the household list.
Leftovers and eating out add nothing.
Checks do not follow a new ingredient id.
Household list
One open list. Revision for handoff.
Recipe lines - summed, with meal ids.
General lines - typed, no model.
States: open, already have, skipped, bought.
still_needed is separate.
Override quantity survives a resync.
Sent, in-cart, and received are not states.
A handoff does not mark bought.
Two shoppers: updated_at or 409.
Handoff
S-03. One URL at one revision.
Instacart returns products_link_url.
No order id until a provider sends one.
Stale when the list revision moves.
Cancelled means we stop showing it.
Their page still does the shopping.
Pantry lot - not built
Later table, same item key.
On-hand, place, expiry, confidence.
already_have is not a starting balance.
